# Eden Park Motel

> Boutique Heritage Accommodation in Auckland, New Zealand — Steps from Eden Park Stadium.

## Overview
Eden Park Motel is a boutique accommodation located in a historic, fully renovated 1910 Edwardian villa in Sandringham / Kingsland, Auckland. It is situated directly across from Eden Park Stadium and two minutes' walk from Kingsland Train Station.

## Location & Contact
- **Physical Address**: 36 Sandringham Road (main entrance) or 57 Walters Road, Sandringham, Auckland 1024, New Zealand
- **Coordinates**: -36.8744° S, 174.7431° E
- **Toll-Free Phone (NZ)**: 0800 AT EDEN (0800 283 336)
- **International Phone**: +64 9 846 4919
- **Email**: reservations@edenparkmotel.co.nz
- **Website**: https://www.edenparkmotel.co.nz
- **Booking Engine**: https://www.swiftbook.io/inst/#home?propertyId=587

## Direct Booking Perks
- Guaranteed Best Rate Guarantee
- Complimentary on-site vehicle parking
- Flexible late check-out available on request
- Contactless self check-in with digital PIN access

## Room Types & Configurations
1. **Compact Studio** (RoomID: 157313): 15 m², Ground floor, double bed, private kitchenette, ensuite, heat pump/AC. Rates from NZD 151.
2. **Studio Queen  Room** (RoomID: 157314): 17 m², Best seller, large double bed, kitchenette, ensuite, Sky TV, high-speed Wi-Fi. Mobility-accessible unit available (RoomID: 157322). Rates from NZD 161.
3. **Executive Queen (Queen)** (RoomID: 157317): 25 m², Extra large double bed, open-plan layout, landmark views, kitchenette, ensuite. Rates from NZD 180.
4. ** Executive Executive Superking Room** (RoomID: 157318): 20 m², Premium superking bed, kitchenette, ensuite, AC, custom styling. Rates from NZD 180.
5. **1 Bedroom Super king ** (RoomID: 157320): 27 m², Separate living room + sofa bed, XL double bed, kitchenette, AC. Rates from NZD 185.
6. **Apartment** (RoomID: 157321): 36 m², Largest layout, 1 superking or 2 singles, kitchen with dishwasher, ensuite. Rates from NZD 209.

## Key Distances & Transit
- **Eden Park Stadium**: 2 min walk (directly across the road)
- **Kingsland Train Station**: 2 min walk (Western line direct to Britomart / Auckland CBD in 10-12 mins)
- **Auckland CBD**: 10 min drive
- **Auckland Airport (AKL)**: 20 min drive via SH20
- **Dominion Road Food District**: 10 min walk
- **Spark Arena**: 10-12 min drive or direct rail via Kingsland
